ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Carving the boat to seek the sword is the old image of fixing a mark where a sword fell from a moving boat and later searching at that fixed mark.
EvidenceBody: Yunxi Ting calls people who deliberate step by step and parse character by character the mark-the-boat-to-seek-the-sword saying fellows, then says they make the teaching into a dead model. Sanyi Yu warns the assembly not to do it, and Yuan’an Feng asks when it will stop. The stored Zen uses therefore apply the inherited image to rigidly retrieving a living exchange from fixed wording; they do not themselves retell every detail of the old story.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: The Zen bend is explicit in Yunxi Ting’s comparison between 刻舟求劍 and treating the teaching as a dead model.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The ordinary moving-boat story supplies the picture, while the stored Chan clauses license only the narrower dead-model and word-by-word application.
